blocks.t: This game has been developed using the concept of the 500GP Motorcycle Grand Prix and uses bikes with the HONDA, YAMAHA and SUZUKI racing colours.
This game has been designed to be used as a three cabinet game rather than three individual games.
Only the colours and decals are different on each bike, all other components are the same. Please refer to the 500GP Manual for details.

Please refer to the 500GP Operation Manual for general installation details.
Set a play zone as illustrated below to prevent contact between players and observers.
The clearance between the floor and ceiling must be at least 2m 30cm. To enable access for service and maintenance, allow a clearance of at least 50cm between the game and walls or other equipment.

‘Approx. 50cm Provide a small space (approx. 2cm) between adjacent ‘Approx. 506m (or more cabinets to prevent screw heads touching each other. or more ‘Approx. 2om LLL LLL MLL NASNONSSSESSNST | Approx. 50em| or more
When Setting the cabinets together ensure that the YAMAHA Bike is on the left (as viewed from the front), the HONDA bike is in the centre and the SUZUKI bike is on the right.
(Fete to the 500GP Operation Manual section 9-2-2 page 82 for general procedures. )
1. Remove 4off torx screw (M5x12) and remove the signal cover (C).
2. Replace the fluorescent tube or starter.
Note: Do not remove the 4off screws retaining the signal acrylic as this will not give access to the flourescent tube or starter.
The 3 monitor mode allows only a single player to play the game using the centre bike
3. with the course displayed accross all three projection screens.
To select 3 Monitor Mode enter ‘OTHER’ in the test mode, Set ‘3 Monitor Mode’ ON on all three games.
. Set the ‘CPU ID’ in ‘Game Options’ of the test mode as follows:
YAMAHA (left) 1 Blue HONDA (centre) 2 Red SUZUKI (right) 3 Yellow
Ensure that the settings for all 3 bikes are the same, i.e. difficulty, lap number etc.
(see section 5-3-5 page 27 and section 7-8 page 45 in the 500GP Operation Manual for details of the Test Mode and how to link games.)
When using this mode it is important to note the following:

Only the centre bike (HONDA) is playable. The left (YAMAHA) and right (SUZUKI) bikes do nort work. Neither the left or right bikes count coins. Please cover the coin entries on these bikes to prevent players inserting money accidentally.
The engine sound will only come from the centre bike (HONDA).
The ‘How to Play Instructions’ in the attract mode is different on the centre screen from the left/right screens.
The following lists of parts only show those parts that are specific to the 3 in 1 game. Refer to the 500GP Operation Manual for all other parts.
